abort.reauth_successful: The Station Key was updated successfully.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The station credentials were updated successfully.

data_description.station_id: The Weather Underground Personal Weather Station ID.
data_description.station_key: The upload key for this station. It is stored as a secret.

user.description:
Configure one virtual Weather Underground Personal Weather Station.

**Next step:** After creating the station, open **Configure** on the integration entry to select source entities. Uploads remain idle until at least one mapping is saved.
user.title: Add station

data_description.station_key: The replacement upload key for this station. It is stored as a secret.

reauth_confirm.description: Weather Underground rejected the credentials for this station. Enter a new Station Key.
reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate station

data_description.station_id: The replacement Weather Underground Personal Weather Station ID.
data_description.station_key: The replacement upload key for this station. It is stored as a secret and is never prefilled.

reconfigure.description: Change this station's credentials without losing its entity mappings or options. When at least one mapped measurement is currently valid, Home Assistant sends one upload with the new credentials to validate them before saving.
reconfigure.title: Reconfigure station

data_description.daily_rain_entity: Entity providing accumulated rain for the current day.
data_description.dew_point_entity: Optional explicit dew point. When omitted, it is calculated from temperature and humidity when possible.
data_description.hourly_rain_entity: Entity providing accumulated rain for the current hour.
data_description.solar_radiation_entity: Entity providing solar irradiance in W/m².
data_description.uv_index_entity: Entity providing the numeric UV index.
data_description.wind_direction_entity: Entity providing wind direction in degrees.
data_description.upload_interval: Time between scheduled Weather Underground uploads.

init.description: Choose an upload interval and map any available sensor or numeric helper to the virtual station. Saving the first mapping starts uploads immediately.
init.title: Station options

test_upload_failed.message: The test upload could not be completed because Weather Underground is unavailable or returned an unexpected response. Try again later.

test_upload_invalid_auth.message: Weather Underground rejected the Station ID or Station Key. Check the station credentials and complete the reauthentication request.

test_upload_no_data.message: The test upload needs at least one mapped measurement with a currently valid value and supported unit. Check the station options and source entity state.
